title: Guardian RTEC Employee Enrollment and Change Packet

content_review.notes: The packet is an unfilled employee enrollment/change form. The original blank contains prompts for private employee and dependent information, beneficiary selections, and signature; completed copies are person-specific records and must remain outside the shared RTEC knowledge corpus.

text_extraction.notes: The PDF renders as vector text but provides almost no Unicode text to extract. A manual searchable outline is stored in reference-notes.md.
